en.title: Maximum Efficiency Picking One Package Before Each Day's Shipment
en.description:
Each day, first pick one package that is still in the warehouse and has not been picked before, adding its weight to the efficiency; then ship out the current leftmost and rightmost packages (only one shipment when a single package remains), until the warehouse is empty. Maximize the total efficiency.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..200000), and the second line contains n weights (0..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: over three days pick 4, 5, 8 in order, for a total of 17. Example 2: over four days you can pick 4, 6, 8, 5, for a total of 23. Example 3: on the only day pick 9, for a total of 9.
hints: Package i can be picked no later than day min(i+1,n−i), so this is weighted selection of unit-time jobs with deadlines. Add packages to a min-heap in increasing order of deadline, and pop the smallest weight whenever the heap size exceeds the current number of days.
